notes.title: The Open World Update
notes.content: Space Space has changed a lot since the first version, has been optimized, and made open world. Jack Diamonds has found the secret plan of the robot squids to destroy the human race. There is a portal somewhere out in the space, and he has built a special probe, to catch the portal signal and locate it. Follow the probe and it'll lead you at the portal, then you'll have to mine space rocks, hunt the mysterious red squid, and collect five red energy dot, to throw into the portal, open it and teleport your ship to the squid's boss. You'll also need to prepare yourself increasing your resistance to the missiles hits, collecting green energy dots. Your enemies, the robot squids, will chase you all the time, and your ship now, is able to move in many different ways, aim and hit the target. I also created a 3D GUI in which you can make Jack change the game settings, walking inside the ship. If you are new to the game you can learn how to fly the ship in the training room.
